summary: Iteration 3 — LX v2 sprint verification. Backend pytest expanded from 27 → 46 tests, all passing (100%). Adapted the legacy TestQuiz to complete the 5 pre-phases + deliverable before submitting, and added a dedicated TestLXv2* suite covering: module-journey enriched payload (hook narrative, 4 objectives, course content_md/reading_min, 5 workshop steps, deliverable min_chars=250, quiz passing_score=0.8, mini_mission brief), quiz-submit gate (400 + 'Complète d'abord les phases : hook, objectives, course, workshop, deliverable.'), phase-tick endpoints (hook/objectives/workshop simple tick; course only counts >=80%), deliverable validation (<250 → 400, >=250 → 200 with signal), mini-mission gate (400 'Passe d'abord le quiz de validation.'), full happy-path (validated status + all 7 phase_flags true), formation/module lock rules (FMS-01 unlocked for FMS user, FMS-02 locked with 50% message, other-pole first formation locked with 'pôle FMS' message; within FMS-01 M02 unlocked after M01 validated, M03 still locked), learning-path shape (6 FMS own_pole + 24 other_poles sorted by pole then code, next_action=FMS-01-M01 for fresh user), and progression/summary counting only fully-validated modules. Frontend Playwright validated: fresh user register+onboarding via API → Dashboard next-action-card (+ next-action-open CTA), Formations catalog ('Ta voie · FMS · parcours séquentiel' + 'Autres pôles' sections, next-action-banner, FMS-01 unlocked, FMS-02 locked with lock-FMS-02 badge), FormationDetail FMS-01 (back-to-formations, module-open-FMS-01-M01, module-locked-FMS-01-M02, progression bar), ModuleJourney locked screen for FMS-01-M02 (module-locked + back-to-formation-btn), and the full 7-phase happy-path (hook → objectives → course scroll+validate → workshop → deliverable submit → quiz open+8 correct answers+submit → mini-mission commit → module-validated-banner + next-module-btn). Post-completion FormationDetail correctly shows M01 as 'Validé' with 'Revoir' CTA and M02 unlocked with 'Démarrer' CTA (M03 still locked). Back navigation from FormationDetail returns to /formations.
critical_code_review_comments: lx.py is_formation_unlocked returns 'Débloquée après {prev_code}.' for non-first other-pole formations without computing prev_status (variable prev_status is set to placeholder 'validated' then unused). Currently harmless because idx==0 branch always short-circuits when user hasn't completed their pole, but the dead code is misleading and should either compute the real gate or be removed.

ModuleJourney.js — clicking 'phase-toggle-{key}' when the phase is already open collapses it (openPhase=null). This is the intended behavior but during automated flows it can create a race with `setOpenPhase('quiz')` performed after deliverable submit. Consider always opening on click (setOpenPhase(p.key)) or exposing a separate 'phase-collapse-{key}' testid for tests.

FormationDetail.js computes validatedCount locally then uses f.progress_pct-like data — but the /formations/{code} response doesn't include a `progress_pct` at the formation level, only per-module status. Consider harmonizing: either add formation.progress_pct to /formations/{code} (used elsewhere in Formations.js from /user/learning-path) or drop the per-formation bar there for consistency.

routes.py get_module_journey returns 'Termine le module précédent d'abord.' as a hardcoded French string when the module is locked-within-formation. i18n-wise this should live in a central copy dictionary or be computed on the frontend from a structured code (e.g. lock_reason_code='prev_module_required').

BackButton.js uses window.history.length > 1 as canGoBack heuristic — that value is unreliable (SPA initial nav counts as 1 even after in-app clicks). Prefer navigate(-1) unconditionally and rely on Link `to` fallback when a specific target is provided (which the callers already do).
test_credentials: Auto-generated fresh users per session — qa-lx2+<uuid>@test.com, qa-lxf+<uuid>@test.com, qa-lp+<uuid>@test.com etc, all pwd=Cvln!2026. Sample browser session created FREK-048..FREK-051.
seed_data_creation: None. All test users created via /api/auth/register + /api/onboarding/complete on the fly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now uses --dist loadscope-safe fixtures: `lx_user`/`lx_headers` is module-scoped and mutated across TestLXv2Gating (which now also owns the module-lock + progression-summary assertions to guarantee same-worker execution). `lx_fresh_headers` is class-scoped for read-only journey shape tests to avoid the pre-state pollution. Correct quiz answer key for the seeded quiz.py template is {1:A, 2:A, 3:VRAI, 4:C, 5:A, 6:C, 7:A, 8:A}. Deliverable min = 250 chars — reused DELIVERABLE_TEXT constant. ModuleJourney's `phase-toggle-{key}` toggles open/collapse — if a phase is already opened by the app (e.g. quiz after deliverable submit), skip toggling. FMS pole has 6 formations, other 12 poles have 24 formations combined (30 total).
rca of the issue: N/A — all LX v2 endpoints and UI flows pass end-to-end. Only backwards-compat concern was the legacy TestQuiz.test_submit_all_correct which now needs prereqs done first (fixed in-place by calling a new `_complete_prereqs` helper on the shared registered user).
